opening.argument: The video shows a $50 Vanilla Visa card beside handwritten card-number and CVC information, then shows the back of the card with more handwritten information. Those details are visible, but the presentation gives no instruction to use the card and shows no audience action, transaction, or outcome. It closes with “Thanks for watching,” while the spoken excerpt is romantic rather than a request involving the card. On this record, the displayed card information does not establish a scam solicitation.

citations.quote: This is perfect, come kiss me one more time.
